title: An agent reports activity without touching the Plan

steps.action: Run task start and task note from a second worktree.
steps.expected_result: Another worktree reads them, and git status stays clean.

steps.action: Run task done on a branch.
steps.expected_result: The record is done there, and another worktree reads done on that branch.

steps.action: Resolve who is reporting with each combination of override, DevSwarm, and branch.
steps.expected_result: The override wins, then the workspace without its repository suffix, then the branch.

steps.action: Compare status, validate, check, and plan deliver before and after activity.
steps.expected_result: Every report is the same, and delivery still waits on durable state.

steps.action: Run the commands with no Git repository and with the log directory blocked.
steps.expected_result: They succeed and say nothing was recorded, and task done still writes.

expected_result: Each step behaves as its acceptance criterion says.
